tools.name: search_pros
tools.description: Find state-licensed home-trade businesses by trade, city, state, ZIP, license number or free text; filters combine. Every result has an active license on the state board's register (with the date it was checked), plus a score (0-100) and rank within its city from theoPros' published formula. Example

tools.name: verify_licence
tools.description: Check whether a license number belongs to a business theoPros lists, which means the license was active on the state board's register on the date in 'checked'. listed=false means it is not in theoPros: theoPros covers only active licenses in its trades and cities, so check the state board before cal

tools.name: get_pro
tools.description: The full public record of one business by id (from search_pros): every license with class, status, issue and expiry dates and the board lookup link, bond, workers' comp, complaint counts, lead-safe (RRP) certificate and its issuer, Google rating and review count, up to 5 Google reviews with author a

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Coverage. Without arguments: each covered state with its cities. With state or trade: every city and trade pair, its number of licensed businesses and its directory page url.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "verify_licence" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Check whether a license number belongs to a business theoPros lists, which means the license was active on the state board's register on the date in 'checked'. …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
